name: topology_update_node
description: Update a specific node's progress, status, active thought, tool execution, terminal logs, budget limits, cost, or emitted artifact payloads in the Topology UI. Automatically routes to the correct plan if multiple plans are running.

planId.description: Optional plan ID owning the node. If omitted, the server automatically resolves which plan owns the node.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to update

status.description: Updated lifecycle status of the node

thought.description: Current live thought or reasoning step to display on the node card

toolName.description: Name of the tool currently being executed

terminalLog.description: A line of terminal output or log message to append to the node telemetry

budgetLimitUsd.description: Allocated budget limit for this node in USD

budgetUsd.description: Allocated budget limit for this node in USD (alias)

costUsd.description: Actual consumed cost for this node in USD

tokensUsed.description: Token usage metrics (number or object with input, output, total)
